name: Pizza Wizard Pachinko Demo
author: srslyradical
description: This is the first thing I've made that actually feels like a game! What a great feeling :) I wrote all the scripts with help from web searches leading me to useful forums and Stack Overflow. The Unity Asset Store is a fantastic resource! All but one of the graphic and audio assets are from Brackeys Free 2D Mega Pack and the happy pizza-loving wizard audio is from Gibberish Dialogue & Voice pack Volume 1 by Rocklynn Productions. Enjoy feeding the pizza-loving wizard!
